Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent's user account in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 8th, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables you to securely deploy agents to access and interact with Dataverse data by using enterprise-managed Microsoft Entra agent identities. It enables agents to be provisioned as Dataverse agent users with dedicated, least-privileged security roles based on their intended capabilities.

The feature ensures agents have only the access required to perform tasks autonomously or on behalf of users. By using identity-based role assignment and full auditing of agent-driven actions, you can enforce security and compliance policies across both human users and agents while maintaining traceability of data access and changes within Dataverse environments.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Create Entra agent users (preview).

Title: Copilot Studio - Create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent 's user account
